title: Stone Origins
description: Currently a single progressive origin that gains powers as you progress
body:
## Stone Guardian
This data pack adds the "Rock Golem" origin which allows the player to progressively upgrade their origin as they go along and get achievements (not commonly done before in public origins). After the Rock Golem you can progress to the Stone golem providing better versions of the buffs before. Next, the Stone guardian which is the final stage and acts as a base for you to select a mini class consisting of: nether, underground, water or none at all. In the future I will add more origins and the data pack will also be available as a forge poly mod and the origin will continuously be updated as I improve my coding skills.
